newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Want Want unit completes $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Want Want unit completes $100 mln loan.

text.p: Wellstand Enterprises Ltd, a unit of Want Want Holdings Ltd, has completed a US$100 million term loan facility with 20 financial institutions, coordinating arranger Rabobank Hong Kong said on Tuesday.
Although the three-year facility drew US$176 million in subscriptions, it was not increased, Rabobank said.
The loan is guaranteed by Want Want Holdings and I-Lan Food Industrial Co and pays a margin of 140 basis points over the one-, three-, or six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 156.66 basis points.
Loan proceeds will be used for plant expansion in China.
Arrangers are Deutsche Bank's Hong Kong branch, Banque Indosuez, Development Bank of Singapore, Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp, Overseas Union Bank and United Overseas Bank.
Co-arrangers are BNP's Taipei branch, Hamburgische Landesbank's Hongkong branch, ING Bank's Taipei branch, Long-term Credit Bank of Japan's Hongkong branch and WestLB Asia Pacific.
Lead managers are BFCE's Hongkong branch, Cariplo's Singapore branch, Keppel Bank of Singapore, Standard Chartered Bank's Taipei branch and Tat Lee Bank.
Senior managers are Banca Commerciale Italiana, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro and Dao Heng Bank.
Signing is tentatively set for July 10 in Hong Kong.
